verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a first-party "Drata MCP — Setup & Usage Guide", and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented there. The developer portal also states it enables AI agents to interact with Drata and manage controls through natural language. The evidence is mostly titles and taglines, so the depth of the MCP tool surface is not shown. Missing for 10: details on exposed MCP tools/scopes, auth/transport specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.
